BJ.name: Taxe sur les véhicules à moteur (private vehicles by fiscal horsepower; company passenger cars)
BJ.statute: CGI 2023 art. 166, 168 1) and 4) (edition 2023, later finance laws not held)
BJ.doc: art. 168: private transport vehicles up to 7 CV 20 000 F, 8-10 CV 30 000, 11-15 CV 40 000, above 15 CV 60 000; passenger vehicles owned or used by companies 150 000 F up to 7 CV, 200 000 F above.
unsupported: public transport tariff by seats / tonnage and three-wheelers (art. 168 2-3)
prorata for vehicles first registered during the year (art. 169)

NE.name: Vignette (annual motor-vehicle tax by fiscal horsepower)
NE.statute: CGI 2013 mis à jour LF 2022 art. 207-212 (LF 2025 does not amend them; LF 2023-2024 not held)
unsupported: exemptions (art. 211: below 1 CV, public bodies, invalids, stock for sale)

ML.name: Taxe sur les véhicules automobiles (vignette, cars by fiscal horsepower)
ML.statute: CGI art. 166, 170 1) (L.F. 2013; DGI consolidation of 2017, later finance laws not held)
unsupported: two- and three-wheelers by cylinder capacity (art. 170 2)
half rate for vehicles bought after 1 October (art. 171)

CM.name: Droit de timbre automobile (annual, by fiscal horsepower; vehicles other than public transport)
CM.statute: CGI art. 597 1) B, 598 (same text in the 2024 and 2026 editions)
CM.doc: art. 597 B (vehicles other than public transport of persons and goods): 2-7 CV 30 000 F, 8-13 CV 50 000, 14-20 CV 75 000, above 20 CV 200 000; collected by insurers with the third-party policy (art. 598).
unsupported: public transport tariff 15 000-150 000 F on a transport licence (art. 597 1 A)

TG.name: Taxe sur les véhicules à moteur (TVM; passenger vehicles by fiscal horsepower)
TG.doc: art. 162 2) vehicles carrying persons: below 5 CV 5 000 F, 5-7 CV 10 000, 8-11 CV 15 000, 12-15 CV 20 000, 16-20 CV 30 000, above 20 CV 40 000.
unsupported: 50 % reduction for road hauliers under the TPU, prorata in the year of acquisition (art. 162-163)

BF.name: Taxe sur les véhicules à moteur (four wheels and more, by fiscal horsepower)
BF.statute: CGI édition 2023 art. 295-1, 295-5 1) (loi n° 029-2022/ALT art. 48); LF 2024 and LFR 2024 do not amend it; LF 2025 not held
BF.doc: art. 295-5 1) vehicles with four wheels or more: up to 8 CV 7 000 F, 9-15 CV 10 000, 16-20 CV 20 000, 21-30 CV 30 000, 31-40 CV 40 000, above 40 CV 50 000.

CF.name: Taxe de circulation des véhicules à moteur (by fiscal horsepower)
CF.statute: CGI 2017 mis à jour 2023 art. 245 bis, 245 bis 1 (LF 2018)
unsupported: category A motorcycles of 150 cm3 and more (5 000 F)

MR.name: Taxe sur les véhicules à moteur (personal-use vehicles by fiscal horsepower)
MR.statute: CGI version officielle janvier 2023 art. 138, 140 1); LF 2025 held only in Arabic, not checked
MR.doc: art. 140 1) personal-use vehicles: up to 4 CV 1 620 MRU, 5-7 CV 2 250, 8-11 CV 2 970, 12-16 CV 4 050, 17 CV and more 7 020.
